identity.author: bedrock-core (drav0011)
identity.description: Custom JSX-driven UI system for Minecraft Bedrock: components serialize into compact strings decoded by a companion render pack, with forms, stack navigation, and i18n.

constraints: Requires attribution: MIT requires retaining the copyright notice
Beta status: breaking changes may occur before 1.0.0
Requires shipping a matching render-pack version (core-ui-v*.mcpack) alongside the addon

customComponents.native_component_api: custom native JSON UI component registration API

uiElements: Panel, Text, Image, Fragment, Button, ItemRenderer base components
Ore-UI styled components (Card, Toggle, Divider, Input, Dropdown, Slider, Checkbox, RadioGroup, Header, MenuRow, ItemSlot, ItemContainer, EquipmentSlots)

customCapabilities.ui: JSX-style custom UI runtime with a serialization protocol decoded by a companion render pack
customCapabilities.navigation: stack-based multi-screen navigation with typed route state
customCapabilities.forms: native ModalFormData-backed forms with atomic single-submit lifecycle
